scenario: A federal contracting officer uses an agent to verify that a construction contractor's certified payroll records comply with Davis-Bacon Act prevailing-wage requirements. The agent parses the weekly certified payroll CSV, computes effective hourly rates per worker and trade classification, runs a DOL payroll compliance audit against applicable prevailing-wage thresholds, and generates a formal compliance determination report.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads the certified payroll CSV and produces a structured summary of effective hourly rates per worker → afrexai-payroll-audit assesses each worker's effective rate against the applicable prevailing-wage threshold and flags violations → reporting generates a formal Davis-Bacon compliance determination.
